Params: {3: 'The test ends for now. Teddy says you can rest until your ride arrives. Just then, the sea breeze carries the distant noise of the festival toward you.'}
{3: "You can't see the crowd from here, but the bonfires and lanterns spill over like a warm river of light."}
{3: 'Vendors call out, people laugh, footsteps pass by, and machines hum in the distance. The sounds go on and on.'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: "Not really. It's probably packed right now.", 4: '101', 18: '100019224', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: "If we run into someone we know, we'll have to say hi and explain what we're doing.", 4: '101', 18: '100019225', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: "You know I don't really like that.", 4: '101', 18: '100019226', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'Rest time is for resting, obviously. I brought tea and a beach blanket.', 4: '101', 18: '100019228', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{3: 'Teddy is about to prepare for the next "mission" when a sweet, smoky smell drifts over. You aren\'t exactly hungry, but the scent is tempting enough to wake up an appetite.'}
{2: "I wonder what they're selling at the stalls.", 3: '37', 4: 'Maybe. Want to check it out?', 5: '38'}

{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'That smell is mostly nucleotide-based flavor compounds. My guess is grilled seafood... Oh, Commandant, want to play another game?', 4: '101', 18: '100019231', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: "I'll admit, I'm tempted. But if I buy it myself, that would go against what I just said...", 4: '101', 18: '100019232', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'Right, Commandant. Want to play another game?', 4: '101', 18: '100019233', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: "We already did a quiz. Let's play something else: rock-paper-scissors. One round. Loser goes to buy food.", 4: '101', 18: '100019234', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{3: "You throw on Teddy's count and lose immediately."}
{3: "You throw on Teddy's count and lose immediately."}
{3: "You throw on Teddy's count and lose immediately."}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: "We can play again, sure. But the famous Gray Raven Commandant wouldn't go back on a bet, would you?", 4: '101', 18: '100019239', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: "I thought you'd fight it a little more. But a loss is a loss, so you're on food duty.", 4: '101', 18: '100019240', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{3: "Since you lost, there's nothing to argue about. Teddy starts setting up a place for the two of you to rest, while you hurry off toward the festival."}
{3: 'Just as Teddy said, finding a seafood stall is easy, but getting through the crowd and into the line takes a while.'}
{2: 'Still, you get the food in the end.', 3: '83'}
{3: 'When you return to the beach with the grilled conch, Teddy has already spread the beach blanket beside the rocks. Two cups of herbal tea sit nearby.'}
{3: 'Teddy pats the empty spot on the blanket, gesturing for you to sit down beside her.'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'Thanks. I thought this tea would go well with grilled seafood.', 4: '101', 18: '100019243', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{3: 'You and Teddy hand each other what you each prepared. As the tea and the bag of grilled conch change hands, Teddy tilts her head slightly.'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: "It kind of feels like we're exchanging gifts.", 4: '101', 18: '100019244', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Then should we thank each other?', 3: '106', 4: "That's not bad, is it?", 5: '108'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: '...Thank you. Hm. Should I say it differently?', 4: '101', 18: '100019245', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{3: "The conch is still hot from the stall. With the tea, the sweet aftertaste doesn't weaken the seafood flavor. It blends with it, making the taste richer."}
{3: 'Before you can answer, Teddy leans back until her still-damp hair brushes your shoulder.'}
{2: 'Teddy?', 3: '122', 4: 'It is good, but... what are you doing?', 5: '122'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'The rocks are too hard... I thought I could use one as a backrest, but it just made my back go numb.', 4: '101', 18: '100019248', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: "So in exchange for the tea, you're going to be my chair.", 4: '101', 18: '100019249', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: "Wait, wasn't the tea for the grilled food?", 3: '127'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: "That was what you owed me for losing. Don't mix them up.", 4: '101', 18: '100019250', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{3: 'Teddy leans back again. This time, she has you turn around too. After a little shifting, the two of you end up sitting back-to-back.'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'Commandant, I have a confession to make.', 4: '101', 18: '100019251', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: "I've actually been testing the coating this whole time, right up to that rock-paper-scissors game.", 4: '101', 18: '100019252', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}

{2: 'Teddy', 3: "We threw out our hands at the same time, but before you moved, the coating had already read enough signals to predict what you'd probably choose.", 4: '101', 18: '100019253', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Before you can finish the question, the moment of first seeing Teddy on this beach comes back to mind.'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'Height, 20 meters. Confirming velocity vector, drag coefficient, and dynamic tracking accuracy...', 4: '102', 18: '100019254', 19: '2', 21: 'v470summer'}
{3: 'Then Teddy caught the ball without taking even half a step.'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'Catching a ball, playing rock-paper-scissors... both can be calculated.', 18: '100019255'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'You can go ahead and be impressed. After all, the reason I ran into you here is because this coating calculated it.', 18: '100019256'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'Of course not. I made that up.', 18: '100019257'}
{3: 'Teddy puts a little more weight against your back.'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: "Predicting someone's whole schedule would be Laplace's demon territory. Even with a bigger processor, I couldn't do that.", 18: '100019258'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'What I actually did was send drones ahead to see where you were going.', 18: '100019259'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'Once I knew your route, I picked a nice spot along the way and waited for you to find me.', 18: '100019260'}
{2: "I had a feeling I'd run into you.", 3: '200'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: "Are you joking...? No, wait. You're serious?", 18: '100019262'}
{3: "The coating must have something like a lie detector. That's probably why Teddy stopped herself just now."}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: "It wasn't a game. I used every bit of processing power to set that up, and somehow your gut feeling still beat me.", 18: '100019265'}
{3: "A soft warmth touches the commandant's lowered hand. Smaller fingers slip between the commandant's, fit into place, and hold on with strength."}
{3: "This isn't a game to win or lose, but you still take her hand and hold on even tighter."}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'This is where you\'re supposed to say, "You caught me."', 18: '100019269'}
{3: 'The sea breeze, the tide, and the distant noise of the festival drift slowly through the air.'}
{3: "You don't need to say anything. Sitting back-to-back, with your fingertips lightly touching hers, it almost feels as if you can hear her heartbeat—and she can hear yours."}
{3: 'Dusk sinks into the sea. The festival slowly quiets down, but you and Teddy remain on the beach.'}
{3: 'Like two shells left on the shore, forgotten by the retreating tide.'}
{3: "For a moment, you think someone else might say that since you're here, you should get up and do something more memorable, something more meaningful."}
{3: "But you don't want to. Neither does Teddy. Because when two people understand each other, simply sitting in the same place and sharing the same time—"}
